lead: Teji Bachchan was an activist, born on 12 August 1914 in Faisalabad.
She died on 21 December 2007 in Mumbai at the age of 93.
The sections that follow break down Teji Bachchan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Teji Bachchan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Teji Bachchan was born on 12 August 1914 in Faisalabad, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India. She was given the name Teji Suri at birth and is publicly known as Teji Bachchan.

sections.heading: Teji Bachchan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Teji Bachchan works primarily as an activist and human rights defender.

sections.heading: Teji Bachchan — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She was married to Harivansh Rai Bachchan (married 1941, until 2003).
She is a parent to Amitabh Bachchan and Ajitabh Bachchan.
